description: JSON-RPC methods shared by every home_state node app. Param schemas use a JSON Schema subset (type, properties, required, additionalProperties, minimum, maximum, enum; default is a hint for the config builder). tools/app_config.py adds each app's 'led' block (firmware/apps/<app>/app.json) to config.set and writes firmware/apps/<app>/methods.json. Keep in step with firmware/main/rpc.c and settings.c.

rf_stacks.description: Radio stack versions this firmware supports. Chosen per profile; recorded, not yet sent to the node.

config.set.description: Change settings. Only the keys given are changed; all apply immediately and persist across reboots. The 'led' settings depend on the app.

update_interval_ms.description: How often the payload (counter, temperature) is refreshed

config.reset.description: Restore all settings to their defaults.

device.identify.description: Blink the LED fast so you can find the board.

device.reboot.description: Reboot the node. A deploy reconnects before the next call.

board.set_id.description: Set this node's board ID (hs-<id>). Per-device: don't put this in shared configs.

device.info.description: Device ID, BLE address, app, firmware, partition, board ID, family.

readings.read.description: Buffered readings for the phone gateway (last hour), oldest first, paged.
